description: This PHP class 'PendingAppraisalReviewSummary' defines a data transfer object (DTO) for summarizing pending appraisal reviews within the OrangeHRM system's dashboard module. It constructs search filter parameters based on an employee number and retrieves pending review counts via service call, implementing the ActionSummary interface.

classes.name: PendingAppraisalReviewSummary
classes.description: A DTO class for summarizing pending appraisal reviews with filtering based on employee number, providing group information and count of pending reviews.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the search filter parameters with reviewer employee number and specific review statuses.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID for this summary, fixed at 3.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the group this summary belongs to, 'Pending Appraisal Reviews'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of pending appraisal reviews based on the current search filter.
